verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since package-manager CLIs can offer JSON output. The pack never documents a `--json` or other machine-readable output mode for any Bun command. The output it does describe is human-oriented: `bun outdated` shows a table and `bun audit` prints a report. The human-readable text-based `bun.lock` file is an adjacent artifact, not structured command output, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get machine-readable (JSON) output from core commands so an agent can parse results instead of scraping text
